2016.summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain model year 2016 Golf R vehicles manufactured March  17, 2016 to March 23, 2016. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
